- Initial public release of the work-productivity-agent-browser-workflow-helper skill.
- Provides workflow guidance and practical support for Agent Browser-style automation tasks.
- Focuses on troubleshooting, reliability, and adjacent workflow creation for popular agent-browser patterns.
